title: Telly Swing
tagline: Swing, plug in and power your way home!
description: Telly is a little cartoon TV with a power cord. Roll, jump, hover and swing through 16 progressively harder Cordy-style rooms with hover-gondolas, turbo boosters, crates, sockets, doors, lifts, fans and bridges, while stomping or cord-whipping Boogaloo's Static Bugs, Volt-Bots and Pogo-Zappers.
how_to: ◀ ▶ roll Telly along and ⤒ jumps; hold ⤒ while falling to fire Telly's hover jets.
🔌 near a glowing hook throws the cord: hold to swing, pump ◀ ▶ for momentum, or swing right round to wrap it for extra speed.
🔌 beside a socket plugs in to power doors, lifts, fans and bridges. Ride hover-gondolas, hit chevron turbo boosters, and push or pull crates onto plates.
Stomp or whip 🔌 at patrolling Static Bugs, Volt-Bots and Pogo-Zappers, grab ⚡ and the three 🔋 in each room, then plug into the gold outlet!
